title: A While, a Way, a Thing
label: ch:manera-y-asunto
canDo: I can say el rato, la manera, el modo, la cosa and el asunto, and say which noun has been hiding inside como since chapter three.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C331-asunto: cut a rato out of el tiempo, choose between manera and modo, and go from any cosa to the asunto it becomes.
